applicability: Experimental current baseline; task/robot/object bindings and parameter applicability must be explicitly resolved for each new task

assumptions: Experimental offline annotation, not a certified protective function
Robot constant surface speed during reaction is an explicit unvalidated assumption (aR=0)
Constant brake deceleration 1 m/s^2 is hypothetical and has not been calibrated against this robot, configuration, payload or controller
Zero speed uncertainty is an experimental assumption, not a measured sensor error bound
Authored non-rigid static human geometry is stationary; moving rigid humans require a configured acceleration bound
Confirmed held payload uses the experimental robot stopping model; confirmed supported stationary payload uses zero stopping travel; other payloads remain unknown
C and position uncertainty budgets are project candidates, not universal ISO constants
Current full-surface speed norms are used as conservative direction-independent envelopes, not finite differences of nearest distance
